claim.input_residual_shape: forall p in coords, |(p.1^2 + p.2^2) - (a^2 + b^2)| <= B
claim.dominance_result: forall p in coords, shiftedSqMod c p.1 p.2 < shiftedSqMod c a b

proves: raw pointwise modulus-square residual evidence builds ResidualEnvelope a b B coords
